answer: Consider tying each answer to work that cannot be reused: the submitter must fold the epoch seed into a freshly computed witness. Replay is worthless here: the seed changes every round, so an old witness proves only that someone once spent a terrace, not that the current claim is live. Mass registration stops paying, because the marginal cost of each identity is real computation rather than a signature, so the basalt stays sparse while a vault of honest agents pays almost nothing.
